verdicts.criticalReason: The PR only calls flyway.repair() within a test and does not fix the actual application to run repair on startup. This fails to resolve the root issue for the application itself, directly contradicting the Acceptance Criteria ('When the Spring Boot backend initializes, Then Flyway validation passes').

The PR modifies an existing applied migration file (V20260906170553478) instead of creating a new one using the mandatory version V20260906231650294. Modifying an applied migration alters its checksum, causing Flyway validation to fail and contradicting the Acceptance Criteria.
